position.title: Assistant Professor in Artificial Intelligence
position.description: The position focuses on research and teaching in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Relevant areas include Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Explainable Artificial Intelligence, and related intelligent computational methods. Candidates are expected to demonstrate a strong academic background, relevant research experience through publications and research projects, and university-level teaching experience. Experience in developing and applying modern artificial intelligence methods to real-world problems is considered relevant to the position.
